resources.string: None yet. Background the app, rotate it, or start a session.
The first three cards need no extra call: the SDK captures taps and text from the views themselves, and each screen logs its own screen view as it opens.
Each screen here logs a screen view with logScreenview when its view is created. The name is the screen\'s own, and the referrer is the screen you came from.

Every touch is logged as a click event: MainActivity forwards touches to the SDK through dispatchTouchEvent. Nothing to call — tap the button and look for the click event in the next post. The control id is the view\'s resource id.
Typing into a field logs a text-change event and the value appears in the captured layout. A value matching a masking rule in ConnectLayoutConfig.json is redacted before it leaves the device.
The sample config masks values starting with SECRET- (MaskValueList): capitals become X, lowercase x, digits 9, symbols #. Compare the two fields in the posted layout message.
